answer: Established members get three vouch slots an epoch. Joining needs a sponsor to spend a slot and lock 40 credits in the crystal registry. A prism audit splits vouches into newcomers, repeats, and linked wallets; a rented slot in one cluster costs its sponsor bond and slot. 1,000 fakes need a grove of 334 sponsors, 1,000 slots at 40 credits: 40,000 for a 40,000-credit pool, so profit is zero. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps a full share.
